_about: Sample emails for the Gmail structured-extraction take-home. Fully self-contained — no access to our stack needed. 'flight-ref' is worked out for you (shows the target shape). 'promo-decoy' is worked too (must come back category 'none'). The five categories in buildThese are yours to extract. Use 'today' to compute a bill's status. All emails are synthetic — no real user data.

targetSchemas.credit-card: statement: { issuer, cardLast4, statementDate, dueDate, totalDue, minDue, status }
targetSchemas.bill: Invoice-like: { biller, account, amount, dueDate, status }  (status: 'upcoming' | 'due-soon' | 'overdue', computed from dueDate vs today)
targetSchemas.shipment: ParcelDelivery: { carrier, trackingId, item, expectedDelivery, orderId }

buildThese: bill (with status: bills / bills-due / bills-overdue are one extractor keyed by status)
note: Bills, Bills-due and Bills-overdue are the SAME kind of email — a bill — sorted by its due date. Extract the bill once and set status (upcoming / due-soon / overdue) by comparing dueDate to 'today'. Credit-card statements are a richer version of the same.
